# claim-responder.yml drops queued burst claims and reads stale issue state

## Context

Design authority: `CONTRIBUTING.md:107` ("Drop a short comment saying you're taking it (`Claiming this` is enough) and open your pull request within 7 days; the repo replies right away to confirm whether the issue is yours or already taken") and `neomjs/neo#19202`.

Live latest-open sweep: checked latest 20 open issues in `neomjs/neo` at `2026-10-21T22:22:53Z` (`#19973`, `#19971`, `#19930`, `#19919`, `#19855`, ..., `#19136`); no equivalent found.
A2A in-flight claim sweep: checked `list_messages({status: 'all', limit: 30})` at `2026-10-21T22:22:57Z`; no competing claim on `neomjs/neo/.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml`.
Memory Core rationale sweep: queried `query_raw_memories({query: 'claim-responder.yml queue max refresh issue state', nResults: 3})` (`20cd0887-ca63-42e1-b4b8-8de8d283bc56`, `46c2e123-45b2-4f4b-a9ff-7cc2286ab43b`, `d23970c1-88cf-49cb-98b8-d5e32a09278b`); surfaced `@neo-gpt-sophie`'s Round-1 review findings on `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1242` (`5606649179`) and `neomjs/neo-agent-institution#781` (`5606649464`).
Own-assignment sweep: checked `gh issue list --repo neomjs/neo --state open --assignee @me` (`#19971`, which scopes `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` regex patterns only).

## The Problem

During Round-1 review of `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1242` (`5606649179`) and `neomjs/neo-agent-institution#781` (`5606649464`), `@neo-gpt-sophie` identified two reliability defects in `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` that were originally inherited from `neomjs/neo/.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml`:

1. **Pending claim events are dropped on burst claims (`concurrency` missing `queue: max`):** `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml:20-22` sets `group: claim-responder-${{ github.event.issue.number }}` and `cancel-in-progress: false` without `queue: max`. Under GitHub Actions' default `queue: single` semantics, if run `A` is active, run `B` is pending, and claimant `C` comments on the same issue, GitHub cancels pending run `B`, so claimant `B` never receives a reply.
2. **Queued runs pass stale `context.payload.issue` state to `decideReply`:** `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml:48-79` reads `issue` from `context.payload` (captured when the comment event fired) rather than fetching the current issue via `github.rest.issues.get`. If an issue is closed, loses its `good first issue` / `help wanted` label, or is assigned while a run waits in the concurrency queue, the queued run still evaluates the stale unassigned/open payload and can post a false `"first in line"` reply.

Both fixes are now merged in `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1242` and approved in `neomjs/neo-agent-institution#781`, leaving `neomjs/neo/.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` drifted.

## The Architectural Reality

- `neomjs/neo/.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml:20-22` defines the `concurrency:` block for `issue_comment` runs on `neomjs/neo`.
- `neomjs/neo/.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml:46-87` runs `actions/github-script@v9`, imports `curatedLabel` and `decideReply` from `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs`, queries comments/PRs/candidate issues, and posts the reply comment.

## The Fix

Update `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` in `neomjs/neo` to match `neomjs/neo-agent-brain/.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml`:
1. Add `queue: max` under `concurrency:` (`.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml:20-23`).
2. Rename `context.payload.issue` to `eventIssue`, fetch the live issue via `const {data: issue} = await github.rest.issues.get({owner, repo, issue_number: eventIssue.number})`, return early with `core.info('No reply: issue is no longer an open curated issue.')` when `issue.state !== 'open' || !label`, and pass the refreshed `issue` (and `label`) to `search.issuesAndPullRequests` and `decideReply`.

| `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` (`concurrency` + `Answer the claim` step) | `CONTRIBUTING.md:107`, `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1242` (`5606649179`), `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs:139-227` | Sets `concurrency.queue: max` to retain pending burst claims in FIFO order, and refreshes `issue` via `github.rest.issues.get` before `decideReply`, suppressing replies if the issue was closed or decurated while queued and passing current `issue.assignees` to `decideReply`. | Returns early without posting a comment if `!body` or if the refreshed issue is closed or no longer carries a curated label. | `CONTRIBUTING.md:107` | YAML parse + embedded callback replay across 3-claimant FIFO burst (`A`, `B`, `C`) and 4 queued state-change scenarios (`closed`, `decurated`, `assigned-to-other`, `assigned-to-claimant`) |

## Decision Record impact

`none`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` includes `queue: max` alongside `cancel-in-progress: false` under `concurrency:`.
- [ ] **AC-2:** `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` refreshes the issue via `await github.rest.issues.get({owner, repo, issue_number: eventIssue.number})`, suppresses replies when `issue.state !== 'open' || !curatedLabel(issue)`, and passes the refreshed `issue` to `decideReply`.
- [ ] **AC-3:** Controlled replay of the embedded `github-script` callback verifies the 3-claimant FIFO burst (`A`, `B`, `C`) and the 4 queued state-mutation cases (`closed-while-queued`, `decurated-while-queued`, `assigned-to-other-while-queued`, `assigned-to-claimant-while-queued`).

## Out of Scope

- Modifying `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` (covered by `neomjs/neo#19971` / PR `#19972`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Relying on `context.payload.issue` in a queued workflow:** Job-level `if:` guards evaluate against the event snapshot at trigger time; once runs queue behind an active run on the same issue, only a fresh `github.rest.issues.get` read inside the job sees closure, label removal, or assignment changes that happened while waiting.
